status: frozen before the registration and before any outcome of this campaign; no label read; prospective
implementation: fsa/rules.py (pure functions; nrm.rules as NR and frc.rules as FR imported unchanged, never monkeypatched); tests: python3 -m fsa.test_rules

inherited.original_limits: NRM1 section 0 unchanged: accuracy loss <= 0.010, NLL excess <= 0.010, summed Brier excess <= 0.005, guards <= 0.005; 24 clauses + 4 guards

tolerances.conventions: differences revised - original of losses and AUCs (negative favours the revised solver); 'no material change' |dAUC| < 0.001; material reduction dAUC <= -0.001; 'no worse' task dloss < 0.0005; material task gain dTotalNLL <= -0.001

route_D.material: partition of >= 1 MODEL_FIT person changed, or a discrete decision input changed, or an AUC input by >= 0.001, or a task input by >= 0.0005

route_E.same_class: same objective (nrm.fa.prc.objective), routing family (nrm.fa.prc.route, constants free, tilt 0 <= t <= lambda), capacity, teachers and start; deployability checked by the unchanged route on every support point
route_E.unrestricted_enumeration: reported only; never advances and never defines the applicable reference
route_E.excluded_laws: any law run by a solver before the registration receipt, including the coordinator's 02:48Z invented-data timing trace (6,000 rows)

route_S.statistics: cached MODEL_FIT out-of-fold statistics, derived from MODEL_FIT training labels (income, occupation, SEX); never described as label-free or untouched
route_S.recovery_rationale: both versions: d pair LOOKUP AUC vs the spend bracket <= -0.001, d total-NLL spend < +0.0005, single views <= +0.010; pooled mean d AUC + 2 x mean SE < 0
route_S.task_rationale: both versions vs the original S2 point: d total-NLL spend <= -0.001, d pair AUC < +0.001, single views <= +0.010; pooled mean d spend + 2 x mean SE < 0
route_S.bracket: the cheapest original path point whose nested spend >= the revised point's spend - 0.0005, else the most-spending one
route_S.nested_bootstrap: B = 400 MODEL_FIT household draws, numpy default_rng(SeedSequence([2026102200, v, 4])), the same weights for both solvers

advancement.supersession: for one revision, a closing route-S label overrides E_ADVANCES (E_SUPERSEDED_BY_S); an incomplete S makes it INCOMPLETE
advancement.equal_effort_control: SV1_first (card FA_FSA_v2): evaluated with the same functions and reported; never advances; equal_effort_attribution is descriptive
advancement.closing_statement: the optimizer-repair hypothesis closes: the original solver matches the applicable reference, or a revised solver improves only the surrogate objective without a usefulness / recovery rationale

reader_validity.bootstrap_seed_rule: 2026102200 + 100 v + repetition index (R1 0, R2 1, R3 2, R4 3)
reader_validity.seed_implementation_error: a seed-dependent recipe equal between its two seeds on a large-support view, or with no large-support check in some (version, repetition) block
reader_validity.expected_invariance: an equality on a view with fewer than 2048 recorded distinct inputs never invalidates; its duplicate cells count once (nrm.rules.aggregate n_eff)

pilot.operating_points: identity (TWIN) + the distinct select_path selections at S1, S2, S3 on MODEL_FIT nested estimates; identical outputs count once
comparators: original PRC and HQ (frc PRC_S2 / HQ_S2 may be reused)
revised PRC and HQ (same variant, initialization TWB_C64, settings and effort rules)
one registered untargeted or ordinary-compression control path
pilot.task_feasibility: nrm.rules.point_eligibility (24 clauses + 4 guards, original limits); reserve reported, never gating; the 0.004 capacity gate is not reopened
pilot.diagnostics: frc.rules.strongest_nonzero; one component ablation; effective comparator refits (reader_validity on R1-R4, k0-k3); never decision inputs
